description: Full name stored as free-text with 30 distinct values and no missing records. Contains cultural naming conventions including Malay patronymics (Bin/Binte) and Indian relational suffixes (s/o, d/o). Two values deviate from the dominant Title Case convention: one in all lowercase ('lim wei jie') and one in all uppercase ('WANG SHI JIE').
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardise deterministic case deviations to Title Case: 'lim wei jie' → 'Lim Wei Jie', 'WANG SHI JIE' → 'Wang Shi Jie'.
